goAnywhere._header_doc: The view's columns are read off its own header line (the operator can show, hide or move columns: on 10/14 the 実行ユーザー column was gone and every later column moved left, so endTime read the seconds and the Jenkins filter let every file through). fields stays the order for a text with no header line. A header without one of the required columns stops the parse (grammar_invalid) instead of reading the wrong column.
goAnywhere._resolved_doc: resolved = the view's 解決済み column (the operator adds it: 詳細 > columns). The status icon is not in the page text; a FAILED job reads No here, every other row blank. optionalTail 1: a page without the column still parses (resolved blank) -- pages.goAnywhere.fingerprint.ok requires the column so the check is never blind.
